prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic commercial fashion portrait on a dark gray studio backdrop dominated by rich red styling.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman with dark brown hair in a neat low bun, luminous natural skin, defined brows, cat-eye liner, vibrant red lipstick, form-fitting ruched red dress with secure sweetheart coverage, long opera-length red gloves, wide-brim structured red fedora and ornate gold earrings; confident look-back pose.
prompt.composition_elements: Portrait framing, dark gray seamless studio background, red hat, dress and gloves forming a unified silhouette, face and fabric texture in sharp focus.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Front-right key light with gentle left fill, polished highlights on lips, earrings, dress and gloves, dramatic depth and controlled red saturation.
prompt.technical_specs: High-end medium-format or full-frame look, 85mm or 105mm portrait lens at f/1.4-f/1.8, shallow depth of field, natural skin pores, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic commercial fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman with dark brown hair in a neat low bun, defined brows, cat-eye liner and vibrant red lipstick, form-fitting ruched red dress with secure sweetheart coverage, long opera-length red gloves, wide-brim red fedora and ornate gold earrings, confident look-back gaze, dark gray seamless studio, dramatic front-right key with soft fill, 85mm portrait lens, rich saturated reds, sharp fabric and skin detail, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, deep cleavage, exposed intimate areas, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, over-smooth, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: dramatic red fashion reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Preserve red dress, fedora, gloves, gold earrings, look-back composition, dark gray background and dramatic light; identity and jewelry design are replaceable.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the reference image. Keep red silhouette and editorial pose consistent, with secure coverage and clearly adult fictional identity.

changes: Clarified adult fictional subject and replaced deep décolletage wording with secure sweetheart coverage while retaining the red fashion concept.
